spans.s: मुगूह m. A kind of gallinule.

मुग्ध a. (f. ग्धा) 1. Pretty, charming, lovely, beautiful; 2. foolish, silly; 3. stupid, ignorant; 4. artless, simple; 5. inexperienced in love, attractive by youthful simplicity, प्रविरला इव मुग्धवधूकथाः R.ix.34; 6. infatuated.

मुग्ध a. (f. ग्धा) 1. Pretty, charming, lovely, beautiful; 2. foolish, silly; 3. stupid, ignorant; 4. artless, simple; 5. inexperienced in love, attractive by youthful simplicity, प्रविरला इव मुग्धवधूकथाः R.ix.34; 6. infatuated.
मुग्धा f. A young girl attractive by her artlessness, (considered as a character in poetic composition).
मुग्ध-अक्षी f. a beautiful-eyed woman, त्वं मुग्धाक्षि विनैव कंचुलिकया धत्से मनोहारिणीं लक्ष्मीम् Am.
